summary.text: Kevin Miller is a Republican state representative from Ohio House of Representatives District 69 who is seeking re-election on the November 3, 2026 ballot. A former Ohio State Highway Patrol trooper, he is vice chair of the Public Safety Committee.

paragraphs.text: Miller lives in Franklin Township, Ohio, and earned a B.S. in environmental education from Ohio State University in 1997.
His career experience includes working as a post commander, labor relations management advocate and trooper with the Ohio State Highway Patrol.
As the incumbent, Miller defeated Charlotte Owens in the 2022 general election and Jamie Hough in the 2024 general election for District 69.
In the 2025–2026 session he was assigned to the General Government, Financial Institutions, Transportation, and Public Safety (vice chair) committees.
